title: The sentences the safety rule must accept

projectIdentity.summary: A service that talks to three providers and holds none of their credentials in this document.

workflow.summary: Run `soil save --project orchard`; SOIL_HOME selects the store. The server prints its data directory, for example /home/ada/.soil-server, and the agent container mounts /home/agent/.soil.

architecture.summary: The service uses an Authorization header. The endpoint expects bearer credentials, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Login returns a JWT. A provider API key exists and is set in the deployment platform.

constraints.summary: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS is set outside the handover. The signing key is a PEM private key held in the platform's secret manager. Public documentation links such as https://example.com/docs are fine.

executiveSummary.summary: Every sentence here names a credential, a header, an environment variable or a path without carrying transferable authentication material. All of it must be accepted.

safetySummary.summary: The client_secret value was intentionally omitted. The database URL is documented as postgres://app:password@db.internal:5432/app with the real password left in the platform. The OAuth app config shows client_secret=YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET.
